name: Tofu Burrito Bowl with Cilantro-Lime Rice & Pico de Gallo

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup basmati rice
1 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small pkg grape tomatoes
1 green bell pepper
1 jalapeño pepper
1 lime
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Quarter the grape tomatoes and transfer to a medium bowl (that will be used for the salsa).
Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Finely dice the pepper and add to the salsa bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, drain and large dice the tofu (cut into 2-cm cubes); place the cubes on paper towels or a clean towel and pat dry.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the tofu to the skillet and season with chili powder, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, 8 to 10 minutes. Once done, transfer the tofu to a bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp chili powder
½ tsp cumin
½ tsp paprika
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the tofu cooks, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; thinly slice one half of the onion and transfer to a medium bowl, then small dice (cut into 6-mm pieces) the other half and add to the salsa bowl.
Quarter the bell pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Cut the quarters lengthwise into 6-mm-thick strips and add to the medium bowl with the onion.

Once the tofu has been transferred, add more coconut oil to the skillet followed by the onion and bell pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until the vegetables are browned and softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Juice the lime; add about ½ of the juice to the salsa bowl and the other ½ to the rice.

Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add about ½ of the cilantro to the salsa bowl and the other ½ to the rice.
Season the salsa with salt and stir to combine.
Fluff the rice with a fork and stir to combine with the lime and cilantro.
To serve, arrange the rice, veggie mixture, tofu, and salsa in a bowl. Enjoy!
